Yes, that feels natural. Adding "typography" right there under the bookmark and seeing it sit next to "design" as little pills is exactly how I'd picture keeping my links organized — the labels stay visible on the card so I can see at a glance what something is, and the "+ Add label" right beside them makes tossing on another one quick. I like it.

One thing I'd want as part of adding labels, while we're here: once I've used a label a few times, I'd expect it to start suggesting itself as I type. So if I've already got "typography" on a few links and I start typing "typo…" on a new one, it should offer me the existing one to click rather than making me spell it out fresh every time — that's partly how I avoid ending up with almost-duplicate labels. Can we make sure the label-adding includes that kind of suggestion?
